item.title: Review: Hitler’s Eagle’s Nest retreat was torched in an arson attack. Should it be rebuilt?
item.description: With the far right resurgent in Germany, experts are divided as to whether the dictator’s former mountaintop retreat is better restored or left a ruin One of the last structural relics of Adolf Hitler’s dictatorship was conceived to project indomitable power. Last month it was destroyed in a suspected arson attack. Will it, and should it, be rebuilt? The historic Nazi mountaintop retreat known as the Eagle’s Nest is perched on an Alpine peak at an altitude of 1,834 metres (6,000ft), with stunning views over southern Germany and Austria. In German, its design is known as Überwältigungsarchitektur , intended to overwhelm and intimidate. Continue reading...

item.title: Review: What kind of prepper are you?
item.description: I have been asking friends and family this question all week. The answers reveal precisely how they deal with fear Perhaps, almost seven years later, there are aspects of the Covid lockdown some are nostalgic about, but it’s doubtful the great loo-roll hoarding of 2020 is one of them. And yet, here we appear to be again. Well, nearly. Some shops sold out of baked beans and water this week, after government advice that we should stockpile supplies to prepare for emergencies “ranging from severe weather to cyber-attacks”. We must Be Ready – which is the name of the campaign that has launched . Security minister Dan Jarvis said that “those who can follow this advice should follow this advice”…

item.title: Review: Are the US midterms going to see a blue wave of Democrats winning seats – or a blue flood?
item.description: Donald Trump uttered five words this summer that could seal the Republican party’s fate: ‘Pretend I’m on the ticket’ He spoke admiringly of a senator’s posterior.
